sources.title: LLMC releases "LLM-jp-4 33B" - A 33.2 billion parameter dense model ...
sources.snippet: The Large Language Model Research and Development Center (LLMC) released August 18, 2026, a dense large language model with approximately 33.2 billion parameters called LLM-jp-4 33B. They released two versions: the base model llm-jp-4-33b-base, which has undergone pre-training and intermediate training, and llm-jp-4-33b-thinking, which has been further trained via SFT and DPO.
